newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT in marketing deal with Kodak.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT in marketing deal with Kodak.

text.p: Dutch paper, office supplies and printing equipment group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent to take over the marketing, sales and distribution of Eastman Kodak Co products for the printing industry in the Netherlands and Belgium.
The Dutch activities will be bought by Tetterode-Nederland and those in Belgium by Plantin, both KNP BT subsidiaries.

A spokesman for the company declined to give financial details of the transaction or the turnover involved. At Kodak Nederland seven employees are directly involved in the activities to be bought by KNP BT.
The deal involves marketing, sales and distribution of films, offset plates and chemicals for printing companies.
The transaction is expected to be finalised by the end of November.
